text: Suppose that $A$ is the symmetric matrix $A=\begin{bmatrix} 0 \amp 6 \amp 3 \\ 6 \amp 3 \amp 6 \\ 0 \amp 6 \amp 6 \\ \end{bmatrix}$, which may be orthogonally diagonalized as $A=QDQ^T$ where $$ D = \begin{bmatrix} 12 \amp 0 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 3 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp -6 \\ \end{bmatrix}, \hspace{24pt} Q = \begin{bmatrix} 1/3 \amp 2/3 \amp 2/3 \\ 2/3 \amp 1/3 \amp -2/3 \\ 2/3 \amp -2/3 \amp 1/3 \\ \end{bmatrix}\text{.} $$ We see that the maximum value of $q_A(\uvec)$ is 12, which occurs in the direction $\threevec{1/3}{2/3}{2/3}$, and the minimum value is -6, which occurs in the direction $\threevec{2/3}{-2/3}{1/3}$.
